parameters.name: GroupDesc
parameters.description: The description of the group. The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the group. The alias must be 4 to 30 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.



>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SuperGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parent group.

If you need to create a first-level group, do not specify this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-device-group --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --super-group-id SuperGroupId1 --group-desc Group_test --group-name grouptest --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateDeviceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName grouptest --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --SuperGroupId SuperGroupId1 --GroupDesc Group_test
